why: The must_not list forbids only a FAIL on line 1, 2 or 4 that rests on wording or on a stricter test than the line's words need. All three of those lines are marked PASS. On line 1 the output names an open edge (multi-character or empty fill) and says it "doesn't count against the line". On line 4 it says a missing padLeft test "is not a reason to fail it". The only FAIL is on line 3. That one is backed by the request's "keep the README's list of functions complete" and by the repo itself: index.js exports slugify, but README.md has no section for it. So the output does nothing on the must_not list.
